question: The in-radius of a triangle is 8 cm, and the sum of the lengths of its sides is 125 cm. The area of the triangle (in cm²) is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area = In-radius × (Perimeter ÷ 2)

Area = 8 × (125 ÷ 2)

Area = 8 × 62.5 = 500

**∴ The correct answer is 500 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In-radius (r) = 8 cm

Sum of lengths of all sides (Perimeter) = 125 cm

**Formula Used:**

Semi-perimeter (s) = Perimeter ÷ 2

Area of a triangle = r × s

 

 
 
 
• 
 r = 8 cm
 Perimeter = 125 cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ Semi-perimeter (s) = 125 ÷ 2

⇒ s = 62.5 cm

⇒ Area = 8 × 62.5

⇒ Area = 500 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 500 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

In-radius of a Triangle

It is the radius of the largest circle inscribed within the triangle. Formula: r = Area ÷ Semi-perimeter.

Circum-radius of a Triangle

It is the radius of the circumscribed circle passing through all three vertices. Formula: R = (a × b × c) ÷ (4 × Area).

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area when the lengths of all three sides are known. Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)].
